card.name: Words that lead into a following phrase
card.fires_on: Small connecting or modifier words that expect a continuation, such as 'than' after 'no more', 'sufficient', 'excessive', 'correct', 'without', 'sure'. Mostly in running English prose.

modes.label: Comparison 'than'
modes.description: The word 'than' right after 'no more' or similar comparisons.
modes.example: keeping in mind the half-life of epoprostenol is no more<< than>> six minutes.

modes.label: Adjectives before a noun
modes.description: Evaluative or quantity adjectives that come before a noun like amounts, rate or curriculum.
modes.example: can be absorbed in<< sufficient>> amounts to produce systemic effects

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Words like 'without' or 'sure' that lead into a clause.
modes.example: Check your child’s blood sugar to make<< sure>> that it is low.
